note: Ship console Log: one entry per completed chapter beat, in story order, shown once unlocked. Edit text/title freely; add an entry anywhere in the list (unique id); remove = delete it. Written only from what happens in the game. Unlock forms: "ch1>=N" (Chapter 1 checkpoint N reached: 0 cell, 1 escape, 2 old passage + ruins, 3 Scree guard, 4 vision, 5 lunar door + take the shape, 6 city reveal, 7 saucer rescue + beam, 8 aboard, 9 galley, 10 free exploration), "venus>=<Stage>" (Landed, GuardianMet, HelpAccepted, ControlDiscovered, EncounterActive, ThreatStopped, RecordReceived, Complete), "scene:<VEN scene id>" (that Venus scene completed), "europa>=N" (Europa checkpoint N: 0 arrival, 1 descent, 2 settlement, 3 machinery, 4 base, 5 workers, 6 escape, 7 temple, 8 home, 9 done), or "never". Mirror: Docs/ADVENTURE-LOG.md.

entries.title: The cat at the cell
entries.text: Held in a cell beneath the Moon, 7 met a black cat who spoke inside her head. His people had sent him to rescue her. He opened the cell door.

entries.title: The older wall
entries.text: He did not know why she was being held, and his people had not told him why they wanted her out. The guarded way was closed to them, but one wall was older than the prison. They followed it.

entries.title: Past the Scree guard
entries.text: A Scree guard stood in their way. 7 got them past without hurting anyone.

entries.title: The door and the shape
entries.text: Touching a stone shape in the ruins, 7 saw the same doorway whole, long ago: two figures opened it and walked through. She took the shape with her. When she had uncovered the buried lock, she opened the door the way she had seen them do it.

entries.title: The terrace
entries.text: Two Scree blocked the way out of the base. 7 knocked them down; they sat up again afterwards.

entries.title: The city inside the Moon
entries.text: Outside, a city filled the Moon’s inner surface, lit windows and traffic curving up overhead. Below the towers, mining machinery was cutting into much older buildings.

entries.title: The ship
entries.text: 7 found her saucer in the impound below the terrace. They released it and went aboard. The cat found it was considerably more ship than he had expected.

entries.title: Dinner in the galley
entries.text: Free-range chicken for the cat. 7 said the vision felt like remembering. The cat recognized an Elarim marking on the shape, and he chose to stay. Next: Venus.

entries.title: Landing, and a name
entries.text: The saucer set down on Venus, where people still live among the gardens. The cat gave his name, Panther, and then grew to the size of a large and powerful cat. He stayed to watch the ship while 7 rode her hover bike toward the temple.

entries.title: The broken path
entries.text: The ride ran under hanging gardens and beside water channels. Then a strong tremor broke the path in front of her. 7 laid a fallen slab across the gap and rode on.

entries.title: The guardian
entries.text: At the temple, 7 showed the guardian the shape from the Moon and told the guardian about the door she had seen. The guardian listened.

entries.title: The cube chamber
entries.text: The temple’s cube bears the same marking; it holds the Elarim’s record. Before she could touch it, another tremor hit. Someone beneath the gardens was forcing the burrowing creatures through the foundations to make the Elarim give up the temple. 7 said she would find him.

entries.title: Beneath the gardens
entries.text: 7 rode the maintenance path to the lower gardens. The creatures were not attacking anyone. Every time a signal sounded, they moved.

entries.title: The Wormmaster
entries.text: The signal came from a chamber full of machines below the gardens. The Wormmaster said the Elarim could leave; it was their home, she told him. Three devices were driving the creatures.

entries.title: The ground is quiet
entries.text: 7 shut down the three devices and closed a barrier around the Wormmaster. The creatures went home unharmed. On the ride back, workers were on the paths again and water ran in a repaired channel.

entries.title: The record
entries.text: At the cube, 7 saw the first planting on Venus, and someone holding out a seed for her to take. The guardian said that moment is not in their record. He gave her a copy of the record to carry; the original stays in the temple.

entries.title: Back aboard
entries.text: 7 told Panther what she had seen. She wishes she could remember the face. There are other temples to ask.

entries.title: Beneath the ice
entries.text: The saucer found a passage through Europa's ice. 7 rode the hover bike down into an ocean, and something enormous passed beneath her.

entries.title: The keeper
entries.text: A Cetacean guide led her to a settlement built around open swimming passages. Its keeper spoke with her - and a mechanical pulse interrupted them.

entries.title: Tunneler again
entries.text: Tunneler's drills were closing the migration routes; he had brought Scree workers who could not leave. 7 went into his underwater base.

entries.title: All of them
entries.text: She opened the holding area. The workers opened doors, showed her the way, and every transport left before the machinery was destroyed.

entries.title: Out
entries.text: Tunneler escaped in his own craft. The base came down behind her as she raced out into open water - and then the calls could be heard again.

entries.title: One voice teaching another
entries.text: In the temple she saw a young one learning a call, and knew the answer before it came. The keeper gave her Europa's record, a small icosahedron.

entries.title: An ordinary sound
entries.text: Back aboard, in the pilot's chair with Panther in her lap: he purred, and that was one sound she knew.

entries.title: Lines across a world
entries.text: Two fortress cities either side of a ravine, and between them a temple older than every wall round it. Both approaches were barricaded.

entries.title: A small problem with real people
entries.text: At the checkpoint, water filters waited behind a closed barrier. Viper looked down from his platform - and noticed the records.

entries.title: The old maintenance route
entries.text: Under the main crossing an old route still ran. The supplies went through; on the far bank the caretaker had heard a different story.

entries.title: The shared door
entries.text: Two controls, one on each bank. Both sides have to open it. Or they used to trust each other.

entries.title: Two controls
entries.text: The worker on one bank, the caretaker on the other, at the same moment. The old bridge aligned.

entries.title: Viper's intervention
entries.text: He divided the crossing with barriers and moving sections. He is secured now - what happens to him is for the people here to decide.

entries.title: History that belongs to both
entries.text: Their two symbols were halves of one design. In the vision both banks built the bridge together. The temple's records show a route out from Mars - and it stops.

entries.title: What she remembers
entries.text: They were both so certain. What if she is doing the same? Keep asking, Panther said. He would mention it.

entries.chapter: Chapter — The Asteroid: the Great Machine Age
entries.title: Something on the rock
entries.text: Silver structures through dark rock, rings turning round an opening, small white lights. Something out here is still working.

entries.chapter: Chapter — The Asteroid: the Great Machine Age
entries.title: Receiving
entries.text: A scanner called me unregistered material and tried to send me to sorting. It preferred a marked crate in the end. Panther found the service entrance.

entries.chapter: Chapter — The Asteroid: the Great Machine Age
entries.title: The city that still works
entries.text: Factory terraces up the walls, rail carriers between them, machines repeating their work. Empty stations. Nobody at all.

entries.chapter: Chapter — The Asteroid: the Great Machine Age
entries.title: Request denied
entries.text: Its caretaker keeps the city ready for its people. He is cutting up the archive to do it. Restoration is ongoing.

entries.chapter: Chapter — The Asteroid: the Great Machine Age
entries.title: The arc blades
entries.text: Two curved blades of light from a maintenance locker. They cut power lines and stun what lives. I held them as if I knew them. I don't know why.

entries.chapter: Chapter — The Asteroid: the Great Machine Age
entries.title: A missed answer
entries.text: The platform went, and the connection with it. Panther went very quiet. So did I. I'll keep talking.

entries.chapter: Chapter — The Asteroid: the Great Machine Age
entries.title: Maintenance interruption
entries.text: He was waiting for them. His tools are locked away and his cradle holds him; nothing of him is broken.

entries.chapter: Chapter — The Asteroid: the Great Machine Age
entries.title: A little bird
entries.text: They stopped the whole line to mend one small bird. I knew what it would sound like before it moved.

entries.chapter: Chapter — The Asteroid: the Great Machine Age
entries.title: Something left for them
entries.text: He keeps what is left safe now. Preservation mode: the essential lights stay on, and for the first time the cavern is quiet.

entries.chapter: Chapter — The Biavian Mothership (Veyra): the Connected Mind Age
entries.title: Among Veyra's rings
entries.text: The old contact route led here: not to Biaveh, but to a Biavian mothership in the rings of Veyra - a sister ship of the one in Saturn's rings. Twenty-six miles across. Three guardian orbs, and a door that opens like an eye.

entries.chapter: Chapter — The Biavian Mothership (Veyra): the Connected Mind Age
entries.title: Three relays
entries.text: Ratwing has cut the relays that join the districts. Old memories are leaking into the living network; people stop in the street, lost in rooms that no longer exist. Nela showed me the way to all three - only the way.

entries.chapter: Chapter — The Biavian Mothership (Veyra): the Connected Mind Age
entries.title: The quiet passage
entries.text: Beyond the shielded door I couldn't hear Panther. It was very quiet. I didn't like it.

entries.chapter: Chapter — The Biavian Mothership (Veyra): the Connected Mind Age
entries.title: Contained
entries.text: Ratwing is shut in an empty maintenance compartment, alive and very annoyed. Panther watched him the whole way. He says the ship was vibrating.

entries.chapter: Chapter — The Biavian Mothership (Veyra): the Connected Mind Age
entries.title: Not yet
entries.text: They asked if I wanted to share what I saw. Not with everyone. I told Panther.

entries.title: Home, apparently
entries.text: Panther sat up for ten minutes before we landed. The old transit tower still has its ball. Several buildings are cardboard; the tree is apartments.

entries.title: He asked to go
entries.text: Juniper told me. He was sent - after he asked. Nobody asked him to stay. I'm glad he did.

entries.title: The last piece
entries.text: The sphere sits in the Grand Circuit's trophy. They've kept it for generations without knowing what it was.

entries.title: The Grand Circuit
entries.text: One lap against Duchess, the champion. {race}

entries.title: Entrusted
entries.text: A traveler left the sphere with a cat, under a leaning tree in a field. They kept it.

entries.title: The field
entries.text: He showed me his greatest form. We ran until we couldn't. When we're finished, we're coming back.

entries.title: The way back
entries.text: All seven records together. The marks line up, and they lead back to the Moon - to a chamber below the city.
